title: Hand in Hand Entering the Secret
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone stepped into the treasure area, a dull rumble echoed from the depths of the secret realm, and an ancient, violent aura surged forth like a tide—and that aura matched the records of the Ancient Forbidden Land exactly.

text.content: Ye Qing's whispered words upon departure were like an icy prophecy. Chen Ji gazed at the rolling dark clouds outside the window, the string named vigilance in his heart tightening once more. How many more chess games remained hidden in the secret realm that he had yet to see through? He slowly closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowing in the depths of his consciousness, a blurry image flashing by—it was the path to the treasure area, and... an unexpected figure.

The next morning, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was bustling with activity. Spies from various forces had already spread yesterday's news everywhere—the Tianqing Sect's well-knowntrash Outer Disciple/Servant had actually been drinking and chatting with the Holy Sect's saint? This news was more effective than any Elixir at arousing everyone's gossip-loving hearts.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stood in a pure white sword robe atop the high platform, her electric gaze sweeping across the crowd. Her eyes lingered briefly on Chen Ji, a subtle, hard-to-decipher emotion flickering in those cool, clear eyes. 'Chen Ji, come here,' she called, her voice low yet distinctly audible to everyone. 'As the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, I need to verify the reasonableness of your whereabouts last night.'

text.content: A wave of whispers rippled through the surroundings. Chen Ji walked briskly toward the platform with his head lowered, his steps betraying a hint of nervousness—a perfect portrayal of being singled out by someone in power. Yet only he knew that beneath those lowered eyelids, his gaze remained as calm and deep as an abyss. The performance? After so many years, he had mastered it with effortless skill.

dialogue.content: 'I... I returned to the Inner Sect Senior Fellow, last night I merely encountered that... that Saint in the restroom,' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, his hands fidgeting nervously. 'The Saint said she wanted to find a convenient place, how could I dare refuse! I only wanted to preserve my pitiful life, I swear I had no other intentions!'

text.content: This excuse was full of holes, and anyone with a modicum of sense could hear the absurdity. However, Chen Ji's expression of 'I'm so innocent, truly so innocent' was so genuinely sincere that it made people怀疑 whether they were overthinking with a petty mind. A meaningful light flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes as she slowly descended from the platform.

dialogue.content: 'Is that so?' Su Qingyao stopped in front of Chen Ji, lowering her voice so only the two of them could hear. 'Then let me ask you this—why would the Holy Sect's saint, a genius of her generation, seek out a mere Servant Disciple for a convenient place? And how do you explain the气息 of demonic path mist on her?' Her gaze was like a sword, seeming to pierce through Chen Ji.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, alarm bells ringing in his mind. Su Qingyao proved to be a formidable adversary, capable of detecting the demonic path mist. Maintaining an impassive facade, he offered a bitter smile. 'Senior Fellow, I truly don't know anything about any mist... Why don't you ask the Saint directly?'

These words seemed submissive on the surface, but were actually a retreat to advance—he knew if Su Qingyao truly went to question Ye Qing, it would cement the rift between Tianqing Sect and Holy Sect; if she didn't go, she'd have to暂时放下此事 for now. Either outcome, Chen Ji could handle with ease. He understood these orthodox cultivators too well—face and the bigger picture, they could never抉择.

dialogue.content: 'Senior Fellow Su is in high spirits this morning, interrogating Tianqing Sect's contributor so early?' Ye Qing's voice drifted from behind the crowd, cool yet带着几分懒散. She approached slowly in a black dress, demonic energy faintly emanating around her, yet appearing not妖异 at all—instead, a cold beauty that kept others at arm's length. 'If it weren't for Brother Chen's assistance yesterday, I would have difficulty surviving that poisonous miasma. Fellow orthodox cultivators, surely you have the magnanimity to overlook this?'

text.content: This declaration instantly sparked an uproar. The demonic Saint personally acknowledging Chen Ji's 'life-saving grace'—what did that mean? It meant there truly existed some transaction or tacit understanding between them. Ye Qing's words seemed to defend Chen Ji, but actually pushed him into an even more dangerous position—from now on, everyone would watch him closely, trying to dig out evidence of his collusion with the demonic path.

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's sudden 'assistance,' how should Chen Ji respond to this sudden attention?

choices.text: Play along and show weakness to gain sympathy
choices.description: Continue playing the role of a frightened little animal, leveraging others'轻视心理 to minimize danger while gaining cover for future actions.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose respect from some Inner Disciples
choices.visible_reward: Reduce direct attention from various forces, lowering the risk of identity exposure

text.content: 'The Saint is too generous!' Chen Ji thudded to his knees, his voice cracking with sobs. 'I only got lucky, that's all—I just happened to know that path could avoid the poisonous miasma! How could I, a mere nobody, dare claim such credit!' He kowtowed as he spoke, the sound of his forehead striking the ground crisp and clear, just like a quail scared out of its wits.

choices.description: Use Ye Qing's words as a springboard, imply that more serious problems exist among Inner Disciples, redirecting the spear to other targets so the crowd has no time to focus on oneself.
choices.visible_reward: Redirect the attention of the entire crowd, allowing Chen Ji to temporarily escape from the eye of the storm

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, the panic in his eyes gradually fading, replaced by a strange calm. He glanced around, his voice not loud but clear: "What the senior brothers and sisters said makes sense. It's just that I wonder, which one in the Inner Sect is this 'expert' who can come and go freely in the poisonous miasma?"

choices.description: Their eyes met, achieving wordless coordination. Since they were already at the forefront of the storm, they might as well play the role to the fullest, making everyone believe this was merely a simple exchange of interests.
choices.visible_cost: Relationship with the Demonic Path confirmed, possibly triggering sect dissatisfaction
choices.visible_reward: Formally establish an alliance with Ye Qing, gaining the protection of the Demonic Path mist
choices.risk_hint: His righteous identity could be permanently damaged

text.content: Chen Ji and Ye Qing locked eyes, that momentary exchange seeming to bridge the chasm between righteous and evil. In the next instant, Ye Qing laughed lightly, taking out a jet-black token from her sleeve and tossing it to Chen Ji: "Since Su Senior Fellow has doubts, I shall entrust this item to Brother Chen for safekeeping - a Holy Sect Pass, which can protect one from demonic energy erosion within the secret realm. Is this sincerity enough?"

The token traced a beautiful arc through the air, landing steadily in Chen Ji's palm. It felt ice-cold, and a pure stream of demonic energy flowed through his meridians, yet he felt no pain from erosion. Instead, it wrapped around him like a film, completely enveloping his presence. In that moment, Chen Ji's evaluation of Ye Qing rose several notches - she was truly helping him, and helping him completely.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes sharply contracted; she was all too familiar with the token's aura - it was a token only core members of the Holy Sect possessed. She took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the shock and doubts in her heart, her voice still cold: "Since the Saintess is so sincere, our Tianqing Sect will not make things difficult. Chen Ji, guard it carefully." She glanced at Chen Ji one final time, then turned and left, her back straight as a sword, yet faintly revealing a trace of... loss?

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Su Qingyao's departing figure, his lips slightly curling upward. She was an intelligent person, knowing that further entanglement would only make the situation more unsightly. This restraint and sense of propriety elevated his evaluation of this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow even further. The more such opponents, the more seriously they deserved to be treated.

The crowd gradually dispersed, yet discussions surged like a tide. Chen Ji held the token, quietly retreating to a corner of the crowd. With the secret realm's opening imminent, representatives from various forces were making final preparations. And his "collaboration" with Ye Qing had been completely established through this turmoil - though in a way no one had anticipated.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing had somehow moved to Chen Ji's side, her voice extremely low: "The first step is complete. Next, it's time to show them what true collaboration means." Her gaze turned toward the secret realm's entrance, where massive spiritual energy fluctuations were emerging, resembling a beast about to awaken. "In the treasure zone, quite a few old friends are waiting for us."

text.content: The secret realm's entrance dramatically opened, and a vast wave of spiritual energy rushed toward them. Elite disciples from various forces entered in succession, and Chen Ji blended into the crowd, utterly unremarkable. Only he knew that the moment he stepped through that portal, the Tianji Record Fragment had already outlined a clear map in his consciousness - the treasure zone lay just three li ahead.

Inside the secret realm, the world transformed. Gray mist shrouded everything, the air permeated with a strange scent intertwining decay and renewal. Beneath their feet were shattered blue stone slabs, flanked by collapsed palace ruins, with ancient runes faintly visible on the walls. This place had once been a remnant of a glorious civilization, now left with only broken walls and endless silence.

choice.prompt: After entering the secret realm's depths, how will Chen Ji and Ye Qing choose their path forward?

choices.text: Take the shortcut through the forbidden land
choices.description: The Tianji Record shows a hidden path leading directly to the treasure zone's core, but it requires crossing an area suspected to be an ancient forbidden land, with risks and opportunities coexisting.
choices.visible_reward: Arrive at the treasure zone before other forces, gaining the opportunity to obtain core fortunes
choices.risk_hint: The dangers of the ancient forbidden land are difficult to predict

text.content: Chen Ji paused his steps, pretending to observe the terrain while secretly communicating with Ye Qing: "The left path, seemingly dangerous, is actually the fastest route to the core area. Can your Demonic Path mist conceal our presence? I'll probe ahead with the Tianji Record - how about it?" Ye Qing slightly nodded, dark mist subtly swirling around her.

choices.text: Progress steadily along the main road
choices.description: Follow the route taken by the main group, advancing steadily, though this will lead to direct encounters with other forces, but the advantage lies in safety and the ability to secretly observe each faction's hidden cards.
choices.visible_cost: Waste time, possibly allowing other forces to arrive first
choices.visible_reward: Reduce risk, preserve more hidden cards
choices.risk_hint: May encounter obstructions from forces such as the Xuanwu Sect

text.content: Chen Ji slightly shook his head, choosing a more stable route: 'No rush. Let them scout ahead first. Following behind, we can observe the strength of all parties and wait for an opportunity.' Ye Qing chuckled lightly: 'I thought you'd choose something more exciting.'

However, before his words even faded, a violent spiritual energy fluctuation erupted on the main path ahead. Immediately, a thunderous roar pierced the clouds—a war cry technique unique to the Xuanwu Sect. Chen Ji's brow furrowed, an ominous premonition blooming in his heart. The Tianji Record Fragment flashed frantically in his consciousness, projecting a blurry vision: Han Lie, blocking a critical passage, seemingly awaiting something.

Chen Ji and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, both seeing a hint of amusement in each other's eyes. Han Lie—that Xuanwu Sect's number one genius with a simple mind but overwhelming combat power—currently lay in ambush. Who was he waiting for? Coincidence, or had someone sent word? Either answer meant their movements had already drawn attention.

dialogue.content: 'It seems someone doesn't welcome us.' Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of mockery, demonic energy beginning to condense around her body. 'I've heard about that big lump—Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect, incredible combat power but no brains. What's your plan? Charge head-on or take a detour?' Her tone carried a challenge, seemingly eager to see Chen Ji's choice.

choice.prompt: Facing Han Lie's blockade, how should Chen Ji decide?

choices.description: Since already allied with Ye Qing, why not take this opportunity to announce to the world—that even waste can turn over a new leaf. Working with Ye Qing for a swift victory, crushing Han Lie with overwhelming force, silencing all who looked down on them.
choices.visible_cost: Consume partial strength, may expose more trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige through battle, making the Xuanwu Sect lose face while deterring other restless forces
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's strength cannot be underestimated, prolonged unfavorable combat will result in loss of face

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, that grin appearing particularly eerie in the dim secret realm: 'Since Brother Han wants to spar, let's grant his wish. Miss Ye, please assist me—within three breaths, I want him leaving on a stretcher.' Ye Qing's eyes lit up, her demonic energy surging instantly: 'Interesting, I like your attitude!'

choices.text: Verbal sparring to probe the truth
choices.description: No rush to act, use words to probe why Han Lie is here—whether he was sent by someone or simply blocking the way. Simultaneously observe if there are other ambushes nearby, collecting intelligence for subsequent actions.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the first opportunity, allowing Han Lie to seize the initiative
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence, preserve complete strength for the treasure region's competition
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's temperament is impatient, may not accept verbal sparring

text.content: Chen Ji reached out to stop Ye Qing, who was eager to try, restoring that harmless smile on his face: 'Brother Han, why must you be so agitated? We're all exploring this secret realm together—keep meeting each other. What misunderstanding might there be? Let's clarify it.' His voice was gentle as if coaxing a child, yet a cold glint flickered in his eyes.

choices.text: Take a detour, sneak through covertly
choices.description: Since Han Lie blocks the path ahead, why not quietly bypass using demonic mist? Superficially confronting Han Lie while actually sneaking through—let Ye Qing's demonic mist conceal their presence,迂回前往至宝区域
choices.visible_cost: Cannot defeat Han Lie in open combat, misses opportunity to establish dominance
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, successfully infiltrate the treasure region's core
choices.risk_hint: If discovered by Han Lie, will be seen as cowardice

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his voice to whisper something in Ye Qing's ear; the latter's eyes flashed with admiration. The next second, thick demonic mist surged forth like a tide, completely engulfing them both. 'Brother Han, farewell!' Chen Ji's voice drifted from within the mist, elusive and uncertain. 'Until we meet again!'

The moment Chen Ji and Ye Qing stepped into the treasure region, a vast spiritual energy fluctuation surged toward them. This area was entirely different from the outside—the sky was an eerie dark gold, the ground covered with unknown metal fragments, each emanating faint spiritual light. In the distance, a massive altar stood at the center of the ruins, and several treasures shimmering with flowing light could be vaguely seen atop it.

However, just as the two were about to approach the altar, the earth suddenly shook violently. The ancient altar slowly cracked open, and a chilling aura rose from within. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—the Tianji Record Fragment flickered frantically, but the projected images were unprecedentedly blurry, as if some force was deliberately interfering with his foresight.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's expression also turned grave at this moment: "This aura... it's the scent of the Ancient Forbidden Land!" Her voice carried a rare hint of tension. "What is sealed beneath the altar?" Chen Ji did not answer, because Mo Xiansheng's aged and deep voice was resonating in his mind: "The second volume opens. The chess game of old has awakened, and you have finally arrived here."

text.content: The cracks in the altar grew larger, golden light and black energy intertwining and缠绕, spurting forth from the fissure. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure笼罩his entire body, that was an ancient pressure, as if an existence dormant for ten thousand years was awakening. At the same time, exclamations and the roar of battle came from the distance—the forces of other factions had also arrived at the treasure zone at this moment.

Chaos had begun. Yet in the center of this chaos, Chen Ji was unexpectedly calm. He gazed at the ever-widening fissure, at the ancient runes faintly emerging from within, and a wild thought surged in his heart—was all this coincidence, or was someone pulling strings behind the scenes? For the first time, the blurry images from the Tianji Record Fragment made him feel a hint of unease.

Just then, a familiar figure flashed across the corner of his eye—Su Qingyao had somehow appeared on the other side of the altar, conversing in low tones with a Tianqing Sect disciple. Her gaze swept past the crowd and landed precisely on Chen Ji, the meaning in those eyes making Chen Ji's back grow slightly cold. She was watching him, had never looked away.

"Fellow cultivators, the Forbidden Grounds have mutated! I suggest we join hands to suppress the seal first, then discuss the distribution of treasures after the crisis is resolved!" The voice of an Xuanwu Sect Elder rang out across the entire area. Various factions responded one after another, only Chen Ji and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, both seeing a hint of vigilance in each other's eyes—was the sudden mutation of the Forbidden Grounds' seal really just coincidence?

Just as everyone prepared to jointly set up a formation, the altar exploded with a thunderous roar. A jet-black pillar of light shot skyward, dyeing the entire sky a sinister ink color. Within the pillar, a blurry figure slowly emerged—that of an ancient soldier in tattered battle armor, holding a rusted halberd, eyes hollow yet radiating a torrent of killing intent. Its gaze swept across the entire crowd, finally fixing on Chen Ji—a gaze spanning ten thousand years, as if examining a long-lost acquaintance.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind once more, this time carrying an unprecedented gravity: "The core of the second volume has officially begun. The residual soul guardian of an ancient Heavenly Secrets master—he has recognized you, or rather, recognized the aura of the Tianji Record upon you." Chen Ji's heart tightened, and before he could contemplate further, the ancient soldier had already raised his halberd, a black sword qi sufficient to tear apart the heavens and earth slashing toward him!

Ye Qing reacted with lightning speed, the demonic energy around her instantly forming a black barrier, barely blocking that sword qi. However, the terrifying impact still sent both of them staggering back several steps, Ye Qing's face turning pale. "Such tremendous power!" she gritted out. "This is no ordinary ancient residual soul, at least... the cultivation of the Heavenly Secrets realm!" Heavenly Secrets realm—that was an existence beyond ordinary cultivators' imagination; even just a wisp of residual soul was enough to overwhelm ninety-nine percent of those present.

Pandemonium broke out across the entire area. Elders from various factions struck out one after another, spiritual power surging like a tide toward that ancient figure. Yet those attacks landing on him were like scratching an itch through boots, unable to cause any substantial damage. He moved like Death walking among mortals, approaching Chen Ji step by step, each step bringing a gust of blood and carnage.

dialogue.content: "Trash!" Han Lie's furious roar rang out from the crowd. "So the Forbidden Grounds' mutation was coming for you! Chen Ji, just who are you?" He wielded a giant sword, battle intent boiling throughout his body. "Today I want to see, without that demonic path witch helping you, how many rounds you can survive, you waste!" With that, he actually ignored the crisis of the Forbidden Grounds and swung his sword toward Chen Ji.

text.content: Flanked from front and back, life and death hung by a thread. Chen Ji's pupils constricted at this moment, yet his heart反而异常calm. The Tianji Record Fragment flickered frantically, the foreseen images clearer than ever before—within three breaths, Han Lie's sword would strike from the left; after five breaths, the ancient soldier's second strike would arrive; and at the seventh breath, there would be a fleeting escape gap in the altar ruins. He only had one chance.

"Ye Qing, cover me!" Chen Ji shouted lowly, his figure suddenly surging forward. He did not evade Han Lie's attack; instead, he charged toward that sword light, at the speed of lightning side-stepping the blade while grabbing Han Lie's wrist, using that momentum to pull him in front of himself—right in the path of the ancient soldier's attack!

dialogue.content: "You—!" Han Lie's pupils dilated, wanting to break free but too late. The ancient soldier's halberd came down with world-destroying force. Han Lie could only manage to raise his giant sword horizontally. BOOM! Han Lie was blasted away, blood spurting wildly, yet miraculously he did not die on the spot. And Chen Ji had long since seized that instant of chaos, his figure like a specter darting toward the altar ruins,钻进into that fleeting gap before it disappeared.

text.content: Ye Qing's figure followed closely behind, demonic path mist churning around her, devouring all incoming attacks. The two vanished into the depths of the ruins one after another, leaving behind a battlefield in ruins and a stunned crowd. Han Lie climbed out of the rubble, face covered in blood, yet his eyes burned with mad fury: "Chen Ji... I swear... I will kill you!"

Deep within the ruins, Chen Ji and Ye Qing stood side by side. All around were pitch-black corridors, the walls carved with obscure runes, each one radiating an ancient and mysterious aura. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out once more, this time carrying a hint of approval: "Well done. You have successfully triggered the main storyline of the second volume. Next, find the seal's core and complete the second page's unsealing of the Tianji Record—there, you will obtain the answers you seek."

Ye Qing leaned against the wall, gasping heavily, yet couldn't help but burst out laughing: "Chen Ji, that move where you used Han Lie as a shield just now... absolutely brilliant!" Her eyes sparkled with excitement. "The number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect, publicly humiliated by a servant disciple like you... if this spreads, Han Lie's face will be丢到姥姥家去了!"

Chen Ji leaned against the cold stone wall, a faint smile curling his lips: "This is just the appetizer." He closed his eyes, feeling the weak pulsation transmitted from the Tianji Record Fragment. "The real storm is still to come." The moment his words fell, a low rumbling came from the depths of the corridor, the ground beginning to shake violently, as if something was awakening.

The moment everyone stepped into the treasure zone, a dull roar echoed from the depths of the secret realm, an ancient and savage aura surging forth like a tide—that aura was actually identical to the records of the Ancient Forbidden Land. Mo Xiansheng's voice reverberated in Chen Ji's mind: "The chess game of the second volume has unfolded, and you have finally arrived here." Chen Ji clenched his fists, a flash of determination flickering in his eyes—no matter what awaited ahead, he would press forward without hesitation.
